text_block_list.text:
Walking past the dorm, I happen to<n>catch sight of
Taiki Shuttle cleaning<n>listlessly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Finally done with the entrance.By now, I bet everybody's already...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The whole dorm's playin' board<n>games today...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I'm on cleaning duty 'cause Ibroke curfew... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the shock of the<n>whole ordeal, Taiki
Shuttle remains<n>down in the dumps for some time.
